## Overview

The International Temperature Symposium is a conference dedicated to advances in temperature measurement science. Its scope includes contact and non-contact thermometry, radiation thermometry, calibration techniques, and uncertainty analysis. Emissivity-related work appears in the context of radiation thermometry and high-temperature measurement topics.
